text:
Predicates:
Born(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
Loaned(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Plays(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
FootballClub(x) ::: x is a football club.
Premises:
Born(ailton, 1995) ∧ FootballPlayer(ailton) ∧ Loaned(ailton, braga) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is commonly known as Ailton and is a football player who was loaned out to Braga.
FootballPlayer(ailtonSilva) ∧ Plays(ailtonSilva, nautico) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazillian footballer who plays for Nautico.
FootballClub(nautico) ∧ FootballClub(braga) ::: Nautico is a football club along with Braga.
FootballClub(fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.
Conclusion:
Plays(ailtonSilva, fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva played for Fluminense.
